verdicts.reason: Both use the same bad crop: the crucifix's head and left arm are cut off at the left edge, and the original full-canvas inset frame has turned into a stray thin rectangle floating mid-canvas across the cross. A's frame sits a little lower and its text sits low, with 'CHURCH SERVICE' near the bottom edge. B's text block sits slightly higher and is better balanced, but it still has the same broken frame and crop.
